suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update the integration test location guidance to mention Cargo auto-discovery in tests/ directory. Current text says 'Integration tests go in launa-integration-tests/tests/sim_tests.rs or src/lib.rs' but doesn't mention that new test files like harness_tests.rs are auto-discovered without needing a [[test]] entry in Cargo.toml.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: harness_tests.rs was auto-discovered without a Cargo.toml entry. The harness tests run correctly alongside sim_tests.
